description: One place Central runs machines in: its Atlas, its proxy, and its Cargo host.

fields.description: The region code, matching the one its Atlas is configured with, such as fra-1. It names this record and appears in every automatic site name.
fields.label: Region Code

fields.description: The 16-bit region number Atlas is configured with. It forms the token audience and bits 96-111 of every mesh address, so it must match that region's own Atlas Settings. A region cannot be reached until this is set.
fields.label: Region ID

fields.description: What a person sees, such as Frankfurt, Germany.
fields.label: Display Name

fields.description: Infrastructure provider hosting this region, shown as the pin's brand mark. Display vocabulary only — distinct from Atlas's Server.provider_type (DigitalOcean/Scaleway/Self-Managed/Fake); reconcile into a shared source if provider identity ever needs to be authoritative.
fields.label: Provider
fields.options:
AWS
Hetzner
Frappe
OCI
DigitalOcean
Scaleway
Self-Managed
Fake

fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. IN. The console derives the flag emoji from it.
fields.label: Country Code

fields.description: Region latitude for the console world map. 0/0 keeps the region off the map (it still lists).
fields.label: Latitude

fields.description: Region longitude for the console world map.
fields.label: Longitude

fields.description: Base URL of this region's Atlas API. Central authenticates with its own signed token, so no credential is stored here.
fields.label: Atlas Base URL

fields.description: Control API of this region's proxy cluster.
fields.label: Proxy Control URL

fields.description: The regional wildcard every automatic site name sits below.
fields.label: Wildcard Domain

fields.description: Leading hextets of every mesh address in this region, such as fdaa:1.
fields.label: Mesh Address Prefix

name: Region
